ball_pre_text: Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma head out to the middle. Keemo Paul takes the ball for their 1st spell
commentary: Keemo Paul swings this length ball away outside off, and Sanju Samson attempts a defensive shot but misses through to the wicketkeeper for a dot ball.
Keemo Paul angles a back-of-a-length ball outside off, swinging away as Sanju Samson cuts, catching the bottom edge for a single to gully, where Shai Hope fields. Sanju Samson gets off the mark.
Keemo Paul oversteps with a length ball swinging away wide outside off. Abhishek Sharma attempts a drive but misses, and Shai Hope gathers behind the stumps. No-ball, one extra.

A swinging ball sprays down leg, and Abhishek Sharma’s attempted pull misses. It is called wide, and a misfield by wicketkeeper Shai Hope allows five wides. India’s WinViz rises sharply from 50% to 58%.
Keemo Paul bangs in a short ball swinging away on leg stump. Abhishek Sharma attempts the pull but misses, and Shai Hope gathers cleanly behind the stumps for a dot ball.
A full ball swinging in on middle stump, Abhishek Sharma gets under it and flicks it high over mid-wicket for six. Abhishek Sharma is off the mark, while India’s WinViz climbs from 55% to 62%.

Keemo Paul sends in a length ball on leg stump, and Abhishek Sharma miscues the drive into the air. He attempted to drive but made an uncontrolled connection, and was caught at square leg by Shamar Joseph. No run. Abhishek Sharma departs for 6 off 4, and West Indies’ WinViz rises sharply from 38% to 46%.

ball_pre_text: Ishan Kishan heads to the crease.
commentary: Keemo Paul angles a back-of-a-length ball on leg stump, swinging away as Ishan Kishan works it through mid-wicket for a single, neatly fielded by Shamar Joseph. Ishan Kishan gets off the mark.

ball_pre_text: Romario Shepherd takes the ball for their 1st spell
commentary: A length ball swinging down leg, and Ishan Kishan gets right underneath it, flicking powerfully over deep backward square leg for six. India’s win probability rises sharply from 54% to 60%.
Romario Shepherd bangs it in on leg stump, back of a length, and Ishan Kishan gets a top edge on the defensive stroke. It runs away for two, with Roston Chase tidying up at third man.

Romario Shepherd bangs in a length ball on leg stump, and Ishan Kishan launches the slog through deep square leg for four. That is the first four of the innings, with Ishan Kishan now finding the boundary twice in the over.
A length ball down leg is swept powerfully by Ishan Kishan, sailing over fine leg for six. Kishan has launched his second six of the over, taking 18 runs from it with three boundaries.
A full delivery strays down leg and is called wide, passing through to the wicketkeeper, Shai Hope. That takes the over’s total to 19.

A length ball swinging away on off stump, Ishan Kishan drives and gets a thick, uncontrolled edge that races through to third man for four. Another boundary for Ishan Kishan, who has plundered four fours in this over, worth 23 runs in total.
Romario Shepherd's leg cutter sits back of a length down leg, and Ishan Kishan miscues the pull towards deep backward square leg for a single. The over yields 24 runs in total.

ball_pre_text: Shamar Joseph takes the ball for their 1st spell
commentary: A length ball down leg from Shamar Joseph, and Ishan Kishan gets down to drive it beautifully through extra cover for four. A crisp stroke brings India a welcome boundary.
Shamar Joseph sends a full ball down leg, Ishan Kishan attempts the flick but misses, and Shai Hope gathers it cleanly. Wide.
Shamar Joseph swings it away on off stump, a length ball driven crisply through deep cover by Ishan Kishan for two runs. Ishan Kishan races to 30 from just nine balls, striking at 333.

Shamar Joseph sends down an off cutter short on leg stump, and Ishan Kishan pulls, but gets it badly mis-timed and uncontrolled. He is caught by Rovman Powell at mid-on, departing for 30 off 10. Kishan’s dismissal swings WinViz towards West Indies, from 22% to 28%.

ball_pre_text: Shreyas Iyer heads to the crease.
commentary: Shamar Joseph angles a length ball swinging in from outside off, and Shreyas Iyer works it away, mis-timed towards square leg. Keemo Paul fields it, and they take a single. Shreyas Iyer gets off the mark.
Shamar Joseph sends down an off cutter wide outside off, back of a length. Sanju Samson drives firmly through extra cover for four. That boundary lifts India to 50 for 2.
Back of a length outside off, Sanju Samson climbs into the upper cut and launches it over backward point for six. That takes the over to 18, with Samson finding the boundary twice.

ball_pre_text: Gudakesh Motie takes the ball for their 1st spell
commentary: Motie sends down a length ball outside off, and Shreyas Iyer drives firmly through extra cover. Keemo Paul misfields in the deep, allowing India to come back for two.
Motie sends down a stock ball back of a length outside off, and Shreyas Iyer drives it towards long-off for a single, neatly fielded by Sherfane Rutherford.
Motie fires in an arm ball as a full toss outside off. Samson drives crisply through backward point for four.
Motie sends down a stock ball on leg stump, back of a length, and Samson slog-sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single, with Hetmyer tidying up in the field.
Motie sends down a stock ball wide outside off on a length, and Shreyas Iyer shoulders arms. It carries through cleanly to the wicketkeeper for a dot ball.
Motie sends down a stock full toss outside off, and Shreyas Iyer swipes across the line. It is mistimed into the deep mid-wicket region, but they come back for two.

ball_pre_text: Shamar Springer takes the ball for their 1st spell
commentary: A length ball outside off beats Sanju Samson's drive and crashes into the stumps. He attempts a drive but misses, and is bowled. Sanju Samson is dismissed for a brisk 16 from seven deliveries.

ball_pre_text: Tilak Varma heads to the crease.
commentary: Shamar Springer goes full outside off, and Tilak Varma pushes it out to long-off for a single, neatly fielded by Rovman Powell. Tilak Varma gets off the mark.
A length ball outside off is slogged, but Shreyas Iyer miscues it towards deep mid-wicket. Shamar Joseph fields, and they come back for two.
Shamar Springer fires in a yorker outside off, and Shreyas Iyer drives firmly to long-on for a single, where Rovman Powell fields cleanly.
Shamar Springer rolls in a short slower ball down leg, and Tilak Varma lets it go. It slips wide of the striker, with Shai Hope gathering behind the stumps, one wide added.
Shamar Springer offers a full toss outside off, and Tilak Varma mis-times the drive into deep extra cover. Rovman Powell fields, and they settle for a single.
Shamar Springer fires in a yorker on leg stump, and Shreyas Iyer works it towards deep square leg for a single. A misfield by Rovman Powell allows the run to come through.
Motie fires in a stock ball on off stump, and Iyer swings hard at the length delivery but misses, struck on the pad for a dot ball.
Motie fires an arm ball full and down leg, too wide for Shreyas Iyer to reach. Shai Hope gathers behind the stumps, and a wide is added.
Motie sends down a stock ball outside off, back of a length, and Shreyas Iyer drives it crisply through the field to long off for four.

Motie sends down a stock length ball down leg. Iyer gets a thick, uncontrolled edge on the flick, racing through to deep backward square leg for four. That is another boundary for Shreyas Iyer, his second of the over.
Gudakesh Motie sends down a stock length ball on off stump, and Shreyas Iyer miscues the drive high towards long-off. Rutherford cannot hold on, allowing three runs.

Motie sends down a stock ball on leg stump, a length delivery that Tilak Varma slog-mis-times into the leg side. It drops safely, and they scamper through for a single, fielded by Keemo Paul at deep mid-wicket.
Motie sends down a stock ball wide outside off, and Shreyas Iyer lets it go through to wicketkeeper Shai Hope. It is called wide, adding one run to India’s total.

Motie fires in a stock ball, a yorker outside off, and Shreyas Iyer drives with an inside edge towards short fine leg. They scamper through for a single, fielded by Romario Shepherd. That brings 15 runs from the over.

ball_pre_text: Keemo Paul takes the ball for their 2nd spell
commentary: Keemo Paul bangs it back of a length outside off, and Shreyas Iyer goes for the slog but mis-times it into the air. He is caught at deep mid-wicket by Shamar Joseph. Shreyas Iyer is dismissed for a brisk 22 from 14 balls.

ball_pre_text: Naman Dhir heads to the crease.
commentary: Keemo Paul angles a length ball swinging in on off stump, and Naman Dhir flicks it crisply over deep square leg for six. Naman Dhir gets off the mark in emphatic fashion.
Keemo Paul angles in an off cutter wide outside off, back of a length. Naman Dhir drives cleanly through long off for four. Naman Dhir has struck two boundaries in the over.
Keemo Paul fires in an off cutter back of a length outside off, but it is called wide as Naman Dhir’s attempted cut misses and Shai Hope gathers behind the stumps. One extra.

Keemo Paul sends down an off cutter outside off, back of a length, and Naman Dhir frees his arms to drive it high over long off for six. Another six for Naman Dhir, his third boundary of the over, takes India to 105 for four after 17 runs from the over.
Naman Dhir flicks the full ball from middle stump away through deep mid-wicket, and Shamar Joseph keeps it to a single. That takes the over’s total to 18.
Keemo Paul fires in an off-cutter on middle, back of a length. Tilak Varma goes for the slog but miscues it into the deep, and they come back for two. That takes the over’s total to 20.

commentary: A full delivery outside off is launched over long off for six. Naman Dhir frees his arms and drives powerfully into the stands.

A full off cutter is pushed wide outside off, and Tilak Varma lets it go through to Shai Hope. Wide called, one extra.
Springer fires in a yorker on off stump, and Tilak Varma flicks it firmly into the leg side. Keemo Paul saves a run at deep midwicket, so they come back for two.
